Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E9 Експлозивен циклон връхлита североизточните щати, завличайки възрастна двойка от Мичиган в масова катастрофа на магистрала. Планинарка губи кураж на върха на Бен Невис.

Могъщите реки S1 E2 Дунав е една от най-застрашените реки в света. Джереми се отправя да търси риба, която е толкова ценна, че престъпниците не се спират пред нищо, за да я хванат, и хищник с човешки размери.

Умът на хищника S1 E2 Докато океанските ловци бродят из моретата, всеки се специализира в свой собствен начин на оцеляване. Стратегиите им се различават, но важат едни и същи правила: оцени, адаптирай се, действай.
Дивата Нова Зеландия S1 E1 Вижте природната красота на Нова Зеландия от Фиордланд - дом на хобитите, до нос Рейнга - северния край, където диви коне тичат по самотни пясъчни плажове.

Сан Андреас: надпревара с времето Разломът Сан Андреас е пресечна точка на две тектонични плочи, простиращи се през Сан Франциско и Лос Анджелис. Той е дълъг 1300 км и в момента е най-проучваният феномен в света.

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E9 Експлозивен циклон връхлита североизточните щати, завличайки възрастна двойка от Мичиган в масова катастрофа на магистрала. Планинарка губи кураж на върха на Бен Невис.
Умът на хищника S1 E1 Котките са едни от най-успешните ловци на Земята. Натурата им е една и съща, но уникалните предизвикателства на местообитанията им оформят индивидуалните им ловни стратегии.

Могъщите реки S1 E1 Легендарният Ганг, най-почитаната река в света, е в опасност. Джереми се отправя към Индия, където разследванията му го отвеждат от ловците на раци в делтата до планините в търсене на рядък хищник.
Живот при температури под нулата S4 E20 С наближаването на края на размразяването, жителите на Аляска се надпреварват с времето, за да се възползват максимално от последните слънчеви дни в Арктика.

Големият бариерен риф S1 E2 Само 7% от Големия бариерен риф е съставен от коралови рифове. Останалата част включва най-старата джунгла в света, стотици острови, блата, пясъчни плитчини и ливади от водорасли.
В очакване на изригването S1 E3 Тихоокеанският огнен пръстен обгражда Тихия океан. Неговите вулкани създават нови земи и местообитания, но могат също да се срутят или изригнат и да ги унищожат.

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E8 Опустошителни кални потоци изравняват със земята калифорнийската крайбрежна общност Монтесито. Внезапно наводнение помита неопитен каякар в Южна Африка.

programme.desc: 次英要求對徐專務和副社長進行特別監察。然而，被選中進行監察的人卻在操縱或帶著證據逃跑。因此，他對塔式起重機司機進行了調查，發現了事故當天的蹊蹺之處。次英在調查一宗價值34億韓元的住宅項目貪污案時，調查了他的大學後輩、住宅事業部部長柳美季。

programme.title: 交易時段
programme.desc: 緊貼市場走勢，為你提供全面訊息，分析港股焦點新聞消息。

programme.title: 宇宙巨人希曼 第22集
奇妙熊寶寶: 解鎖魔法 第9集
杏林在線 第543集
programme.desc: 《杏林在線》採訪團隊每星期走訪各醫院的手術室及實驗室，深度探討不同的醫學問題，以及介紹各種醫療新科技，請來專家剖析和真實個案分享。我們的醫學顧問每集亦會為觀眾解答疑難。

programme.title: 拜託老鷹5兄弟! 第1集
730 玩返轉 第342集
programme.desc: 《730 玩返轉》星星帶觀眾走訪珠海最新商場，發掘場內各式美食，從地道小吃到創意料理，應有盡有。Ben分享名古屋及周邊縣市的旅遊策略，從交通到住宿，提供實用建議。Dani與阿Yuk走進森林，展開一場原野盛宴，在自然中尋找美食佳餚，體驗戶外用餐的樂趣。

programme.title: 直樂VIURIETY 四角無雙 第10集[直播]
神與律師事務所 第16集
programme.desc: 正當以朗準備向娜賢告白時，一個失憶的男孩鬼魂突然出現。同時，娜賢對以朗的感情日益加深，她也開始好奇他的內心世界…

programme.title: WeWa卡玩轉地球呈獻: 港出好味道 第10集
programme.desc: 遇上荷蘭全國性節日，主持跟Terrence的表弟到鎮上狂歡，兼品嚐地道街頭美食—香脆蜜糖餅，還有瘋狂雪糕放題。做完一日店長後，Terrence為主持送上充滿港式味道的改良版小菜，作為慰勞。面對不懂得食蟹的荷蘭人，避風塘小炒會改用甚麼海鮮？如何在創新之餘，繼續保留傳統港式美味？

programme.title: 晚吹 - 總有一瓣喺左近 第464集
programme.desc: 派利是在傳統上是傳遞祝福、保佑平安的方式，但原來隨手收的一封利是，可能帶來的不是好運而是麻煩。今集杜乾彰師傅分享一個朋友在馬來西亞收到一封保平安後，回到香港後遇上種種的詭異經歷，最終又要如何收科？

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度 第1494集
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息。

programme.title: 存酒人 第13集
programme.desc: 燁仔終於跟「賤女人」見面，並了解到她當年做的決定。燁仔繼續歸還存酒，原本要把酒還給D媽，但是只見她的女兒小D代領，而以為燁仔是媽媽新男友的小D，亦不客氣地命令他送她回家。路途上，燁仔發現八歲的小D比同齡孩子成熟，皆因要照顧酗酒的母親，他心生憐憫，決定以過來人身分勸導D媽。

programme.title: 撞鬼自駕遊 II 第6集 -威爾斯中部
programme.desc: 直入威爾斯中部最古老嘅猛鬼劇院，高靈化妝師同導演都話有靈體出現，嚇到全體心都離一離！但193同米露迪仲要挑戰膽量，喺舞台上同靈體溝通，更話要做一樣嘢吸引小朋友靈體！究竟佢哋打算做乜？台上有「人」表演，台下又有幾多「嘢」喺度欣賞？

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB 推介 第1678集
programme.desc: 一首歌背後嘅故事、花咗好多心機嘅MV、歌手同幕後音樂人嘅心血… 《CHILL CLUB 推介》星期一至五晚一於全部都推介俾你！

programme.title: 偶然遇見的你 第9集

programme.title: 大叔的愛－Returns－ 第9集

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: 心計第6季:7
programme.desc: 西蒙·貝克（Simon Baker）飾演派屈克·簡（Patrick Jane），一名受僱於加州調查局（California Bureau of Investigation，CBI）之獨立顧問。他利用出色的觀察技巧（如讀心術），成功偵破多宗大案。他過去經常使用所謂的心靈感應，曾假裝擁有通靈能力的靈媒而成名。派屈克·簡在一電視節目透露使用心靈感應協助警方調查連環殺手「紅約翰」（Red John），他的妻女因而被其殺害。在自責之下，他放棄作為騙人的靈媒，成為警方顧問。

programme.title: 泰坦第1季:9
programme.desc: 《泰坦》故事講述自黑暗崛起的「羅賓」迪克葛雷森成為一支少年團隊的領導者，招募一群即將成為超級英雄的少年，包括「星火」（Starfire）、「烏鴉/酷姬」（Raven）、「戰鷹」（Hawk）與「白鴿」（Dove）等知名 DC 超級英雄將加入這支無畏的團隊。

programme.title: 生活冷知識第2季:13
programme.desc: 歡迎來到由 Kevin Pereira 和 Brooke Van Poppelen 主持的每週節目，該節目以喜劇形式講述了永無止境的日常生活小貼士。 從學習如何用鞋子打開一瓶酒，到找出衛生紙捲的多種用途，永遠不乏有待發現的訣竅。 觀眾請注意：你們的生活將永遠不一樣。

programme.title: 《卡那洛效應特輯》 - 再次相見歡
programme.desc: 麥可重現了飢餓的巧克力兔魔術、令人瞠目結舌的風扇程式，以及與粉絲的驚奇會面和其他魔術，帶來了新的反應！

programme.title: 《卡那洛效應特輯》 - 再現阿茲提克通道
programme.desc: 麥可再啟了阿茲提克通道，並賦予機器鴿生命，以及使用了即時漩渦貨運和其他魔術，獲得了全新反應。

programme.title: Schau dich schlau: Heimwerken

programme.title: Trigger Time Tv
programme.desc: A: Parallax B: Concealment Holsters/Setting up Your Sling C: Skinner 1-10 Optic D: Bi-Pods vs Sandbags.

programme.title: Whitetail Frenzy
programme.desc: Kenny sets his sights on a big Ohio whitetail that's been eluding him for several seasons. Using trail cam intel and patience, he puts together the perfect strategy. Then we shift gears to West Virginia where young hunters get their chance to shine.

programme.title: Claudio Ongaro's Hired to Hunt
programme.desc: On this hunt, Claudio takes a group of hunters on a spec and duck combo in the afternoon after Mel had trouble with his morning hunt; it was messy, but they got it done and wrapped up a 160-bird day for 10 guns.

programme.title: Fishing the Wild West
programme.desc: There is no end to the walleye on Crawling Valley Reservoir in the Brooks Region.

programme.title: Sportsman's Journal TV
programme.desc: Go to Tamarack Island and catch Muskies - that's the plan!

programme.title: Passion For The Hunt

programme.title: How to Hunt With Ryan Kohler
programme.desc: As Ryan and Shawn struggle to connect with bull moose in the remote Alberta bush, Blair St. Martin gets his chance with a bow, and Chase pursues his first-ever moose.

programme.title: The Mellon Patch, It's a Family Thing
programme.desc: A brief peek at what it's like to keep a laying flock through the northern winter.

programme.title: Red Arrow

programme.title: 72 Hours to Survive
programme.desc: Dale meets a hiker on a back trail in Barrhead County, Northern Alberta; Dale then gets lost along the hiking trail and must survive 72 hours with what the hiker was carrying on them for their day hike until rescue.

programme.title: Deer & Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Mark Kayser reveals the secrets to building and positioning mock scrapes to outsmart mature bucks and orchestrate the ultimate whitetail setup.

programme.title: Bloodline Adventures TV

programme.title: Beyond the Blind Hunts
programme.desc: Join the Beyond the Blind Hunts crew in Sylvan Lake, Alberta, as they chase the legendary Sylvan Slam.

programme.title: The Way It Was Tv
programme.desc: Deer season can't come soon enough for the guys, and we're kicking things off in Kansas! Early season brings its share of challenges, but even when the deer start moving, things don't always go as planned.

programme.title: Trigger Time Tv
programme.desc: A: Switching Shoulders B: Mounting a Red Dot/Jawbone 45 ACP C: 1895 Winchester D: Back Country Gear.

programme.title: Mitchell Payment's Moment of Truth TV

programme.title: Long Range Hunter
programme.desc: Pierre goes to Anticosti Island with his friend Stephane to hunt deer.

programme.title: Hit Squad Outdoors With Tim Sylvia
programme.desc: This week Blaine Anthony is in the Midwest hunting whitetail on a hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: Reel West Coast

programme.title: Invitation au voyage
programme.desc: Aux Philippines, un cinéma au parfum de liberté - En R.D. du Congo, des arbres et des ancêtres - A Porto Rico, le flan à la coco de Rebecca - Au Canada se dessine un continent.

programme.title: Dans le ventre des villes
programme.desc: Pleins de couleurs vives, d'odeurs délicieuses et de produits généralement totalement étrangers, les marchés alimentaires sont la première chose que les nombreux voyageurs veulent voir lorsqu'ils visitent une nouvelle ville ou un nouveau pays. Dans cette série, nous nous rendons sur ces marchés merveilleusement sensuels, en nous plongeant dans les différentes cultures qu'ils représentent.

programme.title: Montgolfières en Pologne : rencontre au sommet
programme.desc: Inédit. Dans le sud de la Pologne, la petite ville de Krosno est le rendez-vous de l'élite internationale des pilotes de montgolfière. 101 équipages s'affrontent lors de cette compétition qui vient couronner celui qui dirige son aéronef avec le plus de précision. Lorsque le temps n'est pas de la partie, ce sport aérien met les nerfs à rude épreuve et peut rapidement s'avérer dangereux.

programme.title: Revoir Paris
programme.desc: Mia est sortie physiquement indemne d'un attentat dans une brasserie parisienne, mais est régulièrement assaillie par des flash-backs court et intenses. Trois mois après le drame, elle mène l'enquête afin de retrouver ses souvenirs et tenter de reprendre le cours d'une vie un tant soit peu normale. Elle débute par le lieu du drame, et cherche petit à petit à récolter des indices sur les événements

programme.title: L'année de l'ours
programme.desc: L'écrivain et documentariste Pierre Mann débute sa quête en Roumanie, qui concentre la plus grande densité d'ours bruns d'Europe. Dans les montagnes des Carpates, où vivent les plantigrades, la faune sauvage forme un extraordinaire tissu vivant, aujourd'hui menacé par une exploitation forestière débridée. Au Kamtchatka, dans l'Extrême-Orient russe, le réalisateur suit la trace des grizzlis de Sibé

programme.title: Le golfe de Californie
programme.desc: Le désert de Sonora, caractérisé par son très riche écosystème, sert de refuge à l'antilope d'Amérique, le deuxième mammifère le plus rapide au monde.

programme.title: Le golfe de Californie
programme.desc: Des requins-marteaux aux petits poissons multicolores, les fonds marins du golfe de Californie abritent une biodiversité exceptionnelle aujourd'hui en péril.

programme.title: Invitation au voyage
programme.desc: Inédit. Quatre reportages pour découvrir le Costa Rica : "Walter Ferguson sacré roi du calypso", "le swing criollo, danse endiablée", "la soupe de Denzell", "la guerre des boutures".

programme.title: Invitation au voyage
programme.desc: En Bosnie, la plume désopilante de Sladjana Perković - Le Pays basque sous le signe du métal - En Ecosse, le rôti de cerf de Sorina - En Allemagne, une île qui fait boum.

programme.title: Voyage gourmand
programme.desc: La famille Stietz, qui exerce le métier de meunier depuis des générations près de Stuttgart, redonne vie à des variétés de céréales anciennes et à des techniques traditionnelles.

programme.title: Le dessous des cartes
programme.desc: Ouverte sur le golfe de Finlande, où circule une flotte russe fantôme transportant du gaz et du pétrole malgré les sanctions, l'Estonie vit sous haute tension.

programme.title: Arte journal
programme.desc: Chaque jour à 19h45, la rédaction franco-allemande d'ARTE Journal propose une approche européenne et culturelle de l'actualité. Un regard original sur le monde.

programme.title: 28 minutes
programme.desc: Inédit. 28 minutes samedi apporte un éclairage tout particulier à l'actualité sociétale et internationale de la semaine écoulée. Renaud Dély invite chaque semaine une personnalité connue et reconnue dans son domaine. À ses côtés tout au long de l'émission, elle réagira aux débats et autres séquences de ce rendez-vous hebdomadaire.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Ekstensive's built a lot of trucks, but never a Ford Bronco until now; Bill and the guys transform a rusted '68 Bronco roadster into a high-powered off-roading truck with a supercharged engine, handmade dash, roll cage, and waterproof interior.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The 2018 Camaro ZL1 is already a high performance sports car, but the owner wants Bill to improve his even more; the guys are happy to oblige, starting with a handmade aluminum chassis and interior; a new client wants his Sierra Denali frame dropped.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the gang are back under the hood of the 2018 Camaro ZL1, rebuilding the engine to add as much power as possible before a visit to the dynamometer; Ekstensive tries to turn a patinated 1949 GMC pickup sleeper truck into a keeper truck.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team bring a wrecked '70 Suburban hauler back to life as a long bed, four door, crew cab dually with a 5.9 Cummins diesel engine, custom chassis and suspension; a '65 Plymouth Belvedere II gets some extra muscle with a Mopar crate Hemi.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Rusty and riddled with bullet holes, Bill's neighbor hands over the crumbling shell of a '52 Ford F4 Milk Truck; the guys unleash their best fabrication skills and turn this 60-year-old milk truck into a one of a kind, dazzling diesel street rod.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the guys take a good C10 to a hundred with custom touches from inside to out including one of one interior and bed; Ekstensive makes a dream come true by modifying a 2018 Dodge Demon for an under ten-second quarter mile run on the track.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The wrecked shell of a 1970 Suburban car hauler tests Bill and his metal geniuses as they transform it into a high-end diesel, low, long bed, crew cab dually; Ekstensive makes a lifted and loaded F150 for Boots for Troops, a military charity.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill pushes the shop's creativity with his own build of a 2018 Yukon Denali XL; the luxury SUV is their tallest build ever with a custom lift, straight axles and a supercharger; the '70 Suburban gets a custom chassis and body with a fourth door.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the guys are known for their custom metal work, but the transformation of a 1940 International Harvester water truck into a mobile barbecue pit tests all their skills; a 1986 C-10 is a family heirloom that's remade for future generations.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team try to outdo themselves with a radical redesign of 1950 Ford F5 COE, starting with a bed unlike any they've built; the shop begins its first shot at remaking a '69 Corvette Stingray.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The team goes bigger on the yearlong 1950 Ford F5 COE build when the client asks for a last-minute Cummins diesel engine swap; a twisted graphic wraps up a months-long 2001 Ford F350.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team fix another shop's mistakes when a 2017 F-350 is hauled into the shop broken due to a botched lift; a client insists on the ultimate tailgating BBQ trailer with custom everything.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill knows all too well that families are the lifeblood of the custom truck scene; a customer wants to transform a 1965 Ford Falcon Club Wagon into a fully custom family cruiser; a 1966 Cobra replica gets reinforced.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill looks to the year 2073 when the owner of a '73 El Camino challenges the shop to transform his vehicle into the Ride of the Future; the city wants a custom bumper on a 2020 Freightliner tow truck.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team get their chance to finish a 1968 Chevy C10, which they turn into a unibody by welding the body and bed into one piece; an old dump truck rolls into the shop as the biggest truck the team has ever customized.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: A 1937 International Harvester gets a big old Cummins 12-valve diesel engine that's as heavy as the truck itself; a 2005 Chevy Colorado gets a new lease on life as a nitrous-infused drag truck.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: A 1996 dump truck is the largest truck the shop has ever customized; the guys go extra heavy duty to create a military-styled megatruck; a lowrider enthusiast wants a custom air ride and LS swap for his pristine 1934 Buick.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: This year's over-the-top build has Bill and crew lifting a 2020 Chevy Silverado 5500 more than a foot with a custom heavy-duty air suspension; the guys also prove their Texas mettle by radically overhauling the utility bed.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Hall of Fame running back Earl Campbell arrives with the body and parts of a 1949 Cadillac, and the crew is honored to create a ground-up build for the local legend; a 1940 F-100 build snowballs into a much bigger job.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: NFL Hall of Famer Earl Campbell made a career mowing down defenders, so the guys take the same hell-bent approach to rebuilding his 1949 Cadillac; they also customize a van for a disabled motocross rider so he can drive again.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The team revamps an old school '34 Buick into a modern day lowrider; after months of rebuilding the body and making a custom frame for Earl Campbell's '49 Cadillac, the Hall of Famer challenges the shop with a last-minute wrinkle.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Taking a trip back in time to the early days of the automobile, when the first enterprising car enthusiasts laid the foundations for the car world today.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Some cars carry powerful myths with them long after they are gone; these are stories of cars whose intriguing legends have endured long past the metal they are made from.

programme.title: Super Street Garage
programme.desc: "Hot Rod Garage" built a Nissan 350Z drifter with a welded differential, hydraulic handbrake, steering angle kit and not much else; then they abandoned it; Nads and Amir try to salvage this one with some much-needed style and a Formula Drift debut.

programme.title: Super Street Garage
programme.desc: The boys score a Japanese-spec, right-hand-drive 1997 Toyota Chaser; it's the perfect recipe for a sideways, big-body drift car, but Nads and Amir want to go in a different direction: straight down the drag strip.

programme.title: Super Street Garage
programme.desc: VIP cars include rare body kits, oversized wheels and slammed ride heights; the boys try to build something that's true to the roots of the space and make it to an exclusive VIP party reveal.

programme.title: Super Street Garage
programme.desc: Our quest to transform a drift car into an all-out drag car continues.

programme.title: Super Street Garage

programme.title: Custom Carolina
programme.desc: Tommy and his best friend take a ride back to the '80s; the shop crew transforms a bone-stock 1986 Monte Carlo SS into a LT4 "Monster Carlo" mega machine.

programme.title: Custom Carolina

programme.desc: Tommy Pike and his team restore and modernize a 1955 heirloom Chevy truck.
